observed_structure: The function starts a separate indexed source-offset contribution at zero and visits each selected axis.

Scalar, one-dimensional, and higher-rank index tensors use distinct element-location paths; the higher-rank path selects a row-contiguous coordinate or elem_to_loc over runtime shape and stride metadata.
For each selected axis, the function passes the loaded index value and src_shape[axis] to offset_neg_idx, multiplies the returned value by src_strides[axis], and adds it to the indexed contribution.
A separate elem_to_loc call derives the unindexed source-slice base from index.z, slice sizes, source strides, and source rank.
The function linearizes the output grid coordinates and completes a direct source read into the output using the sum of source-slice and indexed contributions.
variant_notes: NIDX and IDX_NDIM are template specializations; the cited runtime inputs are index values, shapes, strides, axes, and grid coordinates rather than a fully dynamic index count or rank.
The scalar, one-dimensional, and higher-rank index-location branches and the three-dimensional output linearization are gather-specific.
The cited span contains no explicit upper- or lower-bound branch for the loaded index value after offset_neg_idx and therefore establishes no in-bounds or memory-safety result.
